assigned_scope: All handwritten backup producer/CLI plus original test bodies and relevant actual keeper/worker/state/health dependencies

definitions.review: Whitelist code and fixed text; no attacker values/paths. Exception boundary preserves explicit refusal codes.
Single refusal path; validation preconditions do not mutate originals.
Exact int check rejects bool and negatives; uint256 default supports exact raw accounting.
SHA256 for identity only; not authority or source attestation.
Exact shape, case-normalized parsing, optional prefix/zero; manifest trusted pin separately canonical lowercase/nonzero.
Exact EVM address shape with scoped zero exclusion, lowercase identity matches keeper codec.
Deterministic strict finite JSON; newline is manifest representation, not keeper semantic digest.
Reject duplicate JSON object keys including escaped equivalents.
Reject JSON NaN/Infinity without echoing raw values.
Object root, finite floats and post-parse node/depth bounds; byte bounds precede decode. These are not process-RAM or preemptive deadlines.
Int-only finite byte/time resource policy; cooperative monotonic deadline distinct from processing hard supervision.
Explicit daemon-relative base, absolute normalized paths, no dotdot/reparse/symlink/ADS/UNC; new paths require protected existing parent. Ancestors/current UID stay trusted.
Before/open/after metadata tuple pins current read content identity, not cross-host fencing.
Parent/output inode/device checks; same-UID path attacks not universally eliminated.
Require directory and POSIX protected owner/root parent. Windows ACL qualification remains separate.

Bounded read plus descriptor/path/parent identity and regular-single-link checks; fixed FIFO substitution open race with portable O_NONBLOCK and CLOEXEC. Kernel/fsync stalls remain outside cooperative guarantee.
Hash fixed explicit source member paths with same byte/deadline policy.
Exactly same thirteen paths as keeper.health SOURCE_FILES; no daemon import, RPC or running-code attestation.
Keeper-compatible JSON digest has no newline and default ASCII; separate raw config digest intentionally stricter.
Minimal explicit accounting7/custody5/maintenance3/profile pair validation and deployment identity; no Keeper construction. It is not full live configuration admission.
Resolve runtime/signer references against actual working directory, reject path/inode aliases without opening signer files.
Reject known secret-bearing keys/HTTP strings across accepted envelope. Does not prove arbitrary allowed strings contain no secret.
Preserve exact captured schema1/2 envelopes and arithmetic; missing legacy envelope remains explicitly manual, explicit-null rejected; current limits never reprice old pending.
Canonical positive uint256 decimal, no overflow.
Bounded known action key grammar includes 78-digit uint256 bucket strings; preservation does not enable disabled legacy worker.
Metadata ordinal/token/stage/availability/fingerprint shape; current lifecycle2 and dormant/LP-exited stages remain supported.
Typed legacy/current lifecycle identity; helpers preserve dormant old worker data without authorizing tasks.
Bounded contiguous ordinal range and unique IDs against saved identity, not canonical on-chain proof.
Reviewed monitor scheduling/reset/jitter shapes match current cadence and raw history; conversion state preserves explicit native-v4/configurable legacy identity and metadata notification shape.

Strict supported root envelope, config/deployment/accounting identity and counters/anchor/pending consistency; exact data returned unchanged. Full canonical transaction/nonce/accounting checks remain stock recovery responsibility.
Secret-free derived pending facts and manual missing-fee marker, not permission.
Finite exact UTC Unix int input; no implicit bool timestamps.
POSIX parent fsync for directory durability; failures propagate and may leave incomplete output.
Exclusive new protected directory with descriptor-relative mkdir and pinned parent/output identity; no old folder overwrite.
Rechecks reserved inode pair before/after publication.
Exclusive private file plus file/directory fsync and output identity; no partial marker acceptance claim if error.
Prevents output overwriting/containing protected source references; backup additionally forbids source-journal parent subtree.
Read config/runtime mapping, exact supported state and thirteen source hashes without lock, signer or daemon access.
Re-read source/config/journal/producer before completion marker; stable bytes are point-in-time coherence, not newest chain state.
Capture, bounded canonical manifest, exact journal then completion marker; repeated checks refuse mutation; no source rollback or deletion.
Exact two entries, stops at first unexpected item; no unbounded directory traversal.

External pin, exact raw/semantic config, identity/source, capture age/floors, journal bytes, pending-summary equality and repeated snapshot checks; compatible producer hashes remain provenance instead of forced reader equality.
Sanitized wrapper over full selected package proof; false canonical/live/fencing flags retained.
Exclusive new exact journal plus unsigned plan; re-verifies source after journal write before plan completion; no install/lock/health rewrite/service restart.
Suppress rejected values; child parsers inherit class, retaining safe errors.
Offline-only three operations and explicit paths/pins/age; fixed ordinary-exception diagnostics; KeyboardInterrupt not swallowed; no live/install/private-key flags.

confirmed_fix.issue: regular input replaced by FIFO at open can hang before descriptor validation
confirmed_fix.correction: Portable nonblocking and close-on-exec flags; exact regular-file bytes/limits/validators preserved

limitations: No old test body, CLI invocation, server, RPC or public transaction executed by this reviewer.
Reader integrity/freshness is not canonical proof, newest chain state, loaded-code attestation or cross-host fencing.
Input/owner/ancestors remain trusted; byte/node limits are not process-RAM qualification and cooperative budget cannot stop kernel or fsync stalls.
Private helper coupling between alerts and backup remains; no broad validator refactor is justified by this isolated fix.
Existing tests do not prove every worker history combination or physical durability; their synthetic/source/canonical seams retain scope.

primary_reference_review.point: Low-level flags are platform-specific; Unix-only O_NONBLOCK/O_CLOEXEC require getattr portability. Python descriptors are already non-inheritable; the flag makes the kernel open intent explicit.
O_NONBLOCK avoids FIFO open waiting. It does not make regular-file/device I/O nonblocking or eliminate kernel/filesystem stalls.
